body.name: Common-policy confidence-fiber image
body.construction:
For fixed common behavior and deployment kernels \(\mu\) and \(\pi\),
\[
\widehat\Theta_{n,\alpha}
=\bigcup_{\substack{p'\in C_{n,\alpha}\\ \mathcal K(p')\ne\varnothing}}
\Theta_I(p').
\]
The compatibility restriction only removes empty summands, because \(\Theta_I(p')=\varnothing\) whenever \(\mathcal K(p')=\varnothing\).
